sentences.text: The Alberta Alcohol and Drug Abuse Commission produced reports including The Alberta Youth Experience Survey, a Profile on Consumer-Produced Alcohol in Alberta, and a Statistics Report covering the period from April 1, 2002 to March 31, 2003.

The Alberta Alcohol and Drug Abuse Commission also published An Overview of Risk and Protective Factors based on the Alberta Youth Experience Survey 2002, a Mandatory Treatment of Individuals Who Abuse Substances literature review, and a Profile of AADAC Youth Clients covering April 2005 to March 2006.
